title: MOASYS-Vault — movies.json
description: The movies catalog. One entry per movie + edition. Generated by `npm run movies`.

edition.description: Edition tag from filename ({edition-Name}), or null when no edition is present.

tmdb_id.description: TMDB ID from a {tmdb-N} tag — the file's, else the folder's — or null when neither carries one. validate:movies uses it instead of searching.
